title: eaRS Configuration
description: Configuration schema for eaRS (Enhanced Audio Recognition System)

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor support

storage.description: Storage configuration for models and reference audio

model_dir.description: Model storage directory. Use 'default' for HuggingFace cache, or specify a custom path

ref_audio.description: Reference audio directory for language priming

prime_languages.description: Languages to prime on model startup (e.g., ['de', 'ja']). Improves transcription accuracy for these languages from the first words

moonshine.description: Native Moonshine Tiny Streaming engine (optional moonshine build feature)

model_dir.description: Local native ORT export bundle, including a private fine-tune. CLI --moonshine-model takes precedence. If omitted, the public German Tiny runtime assets are downloaded from the official Moonshine CDN into HF_HOME/moonshine (SHA-256 verified). Explicit paths never download or fall back.
Directory containing encoder.onnx, encoder.onnx.data, decoder_joint.onnx, and tokenizer.model. CLI --parakeet-rs-model overrides this value.

language.description: Default multilingual Nemotron language prompt (for example auto, en, de, es, ja). Client/session --lang overrides this value.

websocket_port.description: WebSocket server port for streaming transcription

enable_listener_mode.description: Enable listener mode to allow read-only clients to monitor transcription streams

listener_tokens.description: Authentication tokens for listener clients. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

enabled.description: Enable dictation mode (types transcribed text directly into any focused textbox)

type_live_words.description: Type words immediately as they arrive (true) or only when final transcription is ready (false)

start_paused.description: Start dictation in paused mode (true) or live mode (false)

codec.description: Audio transport codec; use opus for remote or bandwidth-constrained connections

default_server.description: Default server alias to connect to when running ears-dictation

servers.description: Named server configurations for quick switching between endpoints

enabled.description: Show desktop notification when dictation is toggled on/off

start_message.description: Message shown when dictation resumes typing input

pause_message.description: Message shown when dictation pauses typing input

stop_message.description: Message shown when dictation stops completely

audio_history.description: Opt-in local retention of dictation audio for the owner's own training/evaluation data. Off by default; local only; never marks data training-eligible.

enabled.description: Keep one WAV plus metadata per committed dictation utterance

path.description: History directory, or "default" for $XDG_STATE_HOME/ears/audio-history. Must not be inside a git repository

max_total_mb.description: Total size cap; oldest utterances are deleted first

max_age_days.description: Delete utterances older than this (0 keeps them indefinitely)

pre_roll_ms.description: Audio kept before the first recognised word

excluded_apps.description: Bundle ids, binaries or app names (case-insensitive) during which nothing is retained; defaults to common password managers

pause_on_secure_input.description: Pause retention while macOS Secure Event Input is active

start_command.description: Command executed when dictation resumes typing input (leave blank to disable)

pause_command.description: Command executed when dictation pauses typing input (leave blank to disable)

stop_command.description: Command executed when dictation stops completely (leave blank to disable)

wake.description: Optional wake-phrase trigger. eaRS streams 16 kHz audio while dictation is paused to an external detector process (wake-stream/1) and maps reported phrases to actions. Evidence only: a detection can do what the toggle hotkey does, nothing more.

actions.description: Phrase reported by the detector -> action; unlisted phrases are ignored

min_score.description: Optional extra score floor on top of the detector's threshold

preroll_ms.description: Audio before the detection sent to the server after a wake so the first words are kept

strip_words.description: Leading words dropped once after a wake (the wake phrase as the ASR spells it)

stop_phrases.description: Whole utterances that pause capture without typing; punctuation is ignored

log.description: Write detections and near misses (no audio) to a local JSONL log

hotkeys.description: Global hotkey configuration for dictation control

enable_internal.description: Enable internal global hotkeys for dictation control (disable if using WM binds like Hyprland)

mode.description: Dictation control mode: toggle, hold-to-talk, or hybrid

language_cycle.description: Cycle language among en, de, fr, es, ja

x_position.description: Horizontal position of the subtitle bar in percent relative to screen width

y_position.description: Vertical position of the subtitle bar in percent relative to screen height

width.description: Width of the subtitle bar in percentage relative to screen width

heigth.description: Height of the subtitle bar in percentage relative to screen height

border_thickness.description: Border thickness in pixels (0 for no border)

transcribe_cpp.description: transcribe.cpp GGUF streaming engine configuration (requires the transcribe-cpp feature)

model_path.description: Either an existing .gguf path or a known model slug auto-downloaded from the handy-computer HF org on first use (e.g. multitalker-parakeet-streaming-0.6b-v1, nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b). Append @QUANT for a non-default quant. Enables --engine transcribe-cpp; CLI --transcribe-cpp-model overrides this.

language.description: Language hint for multilingual models (e.g. 'de'). 'auto' or unset lets the model autodetect; a dictation client --lang overrides per session.
